verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an attorney-led immigration filing service: it offers guided intake, evidence organization, attorney review and USCIS filing, with internal 'AI workflows'. It does not present itself as an AI assistant or agent that a user drives, so plugging in user-supplied MCP servers as a tool-calling client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such client capability, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
